title: tk cloud trace refuses a short run id instead of resolving it
description:
Found by fxf while using the command that landed the same day. tk cloud trace run_62c289d1 answers "No AI Gateway calls are stamped with run run_62c289d1" — technically true and completely misleading, because gateway metadata carries the full id (run_62c289d1e57942cea5fef6c1a508a0fd) and every other tk surface accepts a short id. The operator reads it as "there is no telemetry for this run" and stops, which is the opposite of what the command exists for.

Resolve a prefix against the runs the factory knows about and say so, or refuse with "that is a prefix, did you mean <full id>" — never answer a prefix with a confident negative. Check the same trap on tk cloud logs and tk cloud status while in there.
